summary: classNames.historyBackdrop styles the backdrop of the full-screen chat drawer; the drawer states (data-drawer="true", hidden, role="dialog") are documented as stable. The docked sidebar no longer triggers React's flex/flexShrink style warning.
howTo: Replace CSS on [data-element="history-backdrop"] with classNames={{ historyBackdrop: 'my-backdrop' }} if you like; the attribute selector keeps working. Select the drawer with [data-element="history"][data-drawer], the open one with :not([hidden]). Nothing to do for the style fix: after the window grows past narrowWidth the sidebar keeps flex-shrink: 0 again, as on a fresh mount. A renderButton that opens a tooltip on focus shows it when focus returns to the chats toggle after the drawer closes; open it on :focus-visible or hover only. See placing-the-assistant.md, Replacing shell parts.
